<h2>Summarise Pollen Counts by Sample</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Summarises the total pollen count for each sample.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>summarise_pollen_counts_by_sample(data_community = NULL)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_community">data_community</code></td>
<td>
<p>A data frame containing 'sample_name' and 'pollen_count' columns.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Missing values in 'pollen_count' are ignored.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A data frame with two columns: 'sample_name' and 'pollen_sum',
where 'pollen_sum' is the total pollen count for each sample.
</p>

</main>
